about_the_game:
Cat Piano for Kids is a fun and playful music game designed especially for children! Instead of classic piano notes, every key makes the sound of an animal – meowing cats, barking dogs, mooing cows, quacking ducks, and many more. It’s the perfect mix of music, laughter, and learning.

Bright, colorful, and easy to play, this game is perfect for toddlers, preschoolers, and young children who want to explore music in a silly and creative way.
